title: Senior Backend Engineer
description: Design and build APIs, integrations and data pipelines for clients in finance and logistics. You will lead technical decisions on projects of three to six people.
We are looking for 5+ years with Node.js or Python, solid PostgreSQL, and experience running production systems on AWS or Azure.

title: Frontend Engineer
description: Build fast, accessible interfaces in React and Next.js, working closely with our designers from the first prototype to production.
3+ years with TypeScript and React. You care about performance budgets and keyboard users.

title: Cloud and DevOps Engineer
description: Plan and run cloud migrations, write Terraform, and set up the CI/CD pipelines our project teams rely on.
Hands-on AWS or Azure, Terraform, Docker, and at least one migration you can talk us through in detail.

title: Product Designer
description: Run discovery workshops, user interviews and usability tests, then turn what you learn into prototypes and production-ready interfaces.
A portfolio that shows your process, not only final screens. Experience with complex internal tools is a plus.
